Summary: When Scott McCall is bitten by something lurking in the Beacon Hills woods, Stiles Stilinski refuses to believe it's just another animal attack. As a brutal murder rocks the town and the police scramble for answers, Stiles begins piecing together clues that point toward something impossible: werewolves are real. Determined to protect his best friend from a transformation neither of them understands, Stiles dives headfirst into old folklore, dangerous investigations, and secrets the Hale family has buried for years. The deeper he digs, the more he realizes Beacon Hills has been hiding monsters long before Scott was ever bitten. And somewhere in the darkness, a pair of blue eyes keeps watching him.
